name: formal_greeting
description: A new customer sends a formal, polite greeting requesting product information. Tests that the AI responds warmly and asks clarifying questions rather than jumping straight to quoting.

messages.text: Good morning, I would like to inquire about your products.

expected_behaviors.description: At least one assistant reply expected
Reply should acknowledge the greeting warmly
Reply should ask what the customer needs (material type, size, quantity)

forbidden_patterns.description: No pricing or quotes in the greeting response

notes: The AI should respond warmly to the formal greeting and ask clarifying questions about what the customer is looking for (material type, board size, quantity). It should NOT attempt to quote prices or call any tools since no product details have been provided yet.
